nodes.summary: It is not the case that for every colouring of the real numbers with two colours there is a set $A \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ of cardinality $\aleph_1$ such that all sums $a + b$ with $a, b \in A$ and $a \ne b$ have the same colour.
